IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Senate Judiciary (originally sponsored by Senators Kline, Delvin, Brandland, and Hargrove)

Bill.BriefDescription: Stating the policy that law enforcement personnel be truthful and honest in the conduct of official business.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to law enforcement officer conduct; and adding anew section to chapter 43.101 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.101 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: It is the policy of the state of Washington that all commissioned,appointed, and elected law enforcement personnel be truthful and honestin the conduct of their official business.
